outcome: local inflammation (measured by CD11b+CD45+ and Ly6G+ cells, iNOS, TNFa protein expression)
cohort: The study participants were ICH-bearing mice.
finding: Intravenous hAMSC administration during the acute phase effectively improved ICH-induced neurobehavioral deficits in mice by suppressing subacute inflammation and apoptosis through a reduction in macrophage/microglia cell numbers and their functions.
